question: India is a member of the General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade (GATT) since _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1948.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Point__**

__
 
• India has been a WTO member since 1 January 1995 and a member of **GATT since 8 July 1948.**
 
• World Trade Organization:
 
 
• The World Trade Organization(WTO) was **founded in the year 1995 **as the successor organisation to the General Agreement on Trade and Tariffs (GATT).
 
• **GATT was established in 1948 with 23 countries as the global trade organisation **to administer all multilateral trade agreements by providing equal opportunities to all countries in the international market for trading purposes.
 
• WTO was** established to enlarge the production and trade of services**, to ensure the optimum utilisation of world resources and to protect the environment.
 
• India has kept its commitments towards the liberalisation of trade, made in the WTO, by removing restrictions on imports and reducing tariff rates.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The headquarters of WTO is in Geneva, Switzerland.
 
• WTO has had 164 members since 29 July 2016, Afghanistan is the 164th member of the WTO.
 
• Roberto Azevedo is the director general of WTO.
